# Scoreboard

## How to update this

22 metrics in 3 groups — 7 Engineering / 7 Agent harness / 8 Business.

Write your readings inside the `<!-- user:actuals -->` block under each metric and nowhere
else; weekly logging never requires touching YAML. `make regen` rewrites every generated line
here and copies your blocks across byte-for-byte, reattaching them by metric id, so a canon
edit that reorders the metrics cannot misalign your numbers.

Every business row carries `evidence_source: real | simulated`. A simulated reading logged as
real is the one failure this scoreboard cannot detect. Paid pilots and revenue are NEVER simulated.

```text
<week id> | <ISO date> | <reading> | evidence_source: real|simulated
W01 | 2026-09-06 | 10 prospects researched, 0 sends | evidence_source: real
```

One line per week, newest last, four positional fields, so a month-end pull needs no parser. The week id is the anchor: this programme runs on week-files, not calendar weeks. "The week's funnel row" in a criterion means SM-15, SM-16, SM-17 or SM-18 in this shape.

Funnel volumes for the twelve detailed weeks: 56 prospects researched, 52 sends, 104 follow-ups, 2 opportunities scored. Reply rate is expected in the
1.5–8% band and reply-to-call at 15–35%; both DIRECTIONAL, NOT PREDICTIVE, and the
month-02 delta is expected to move them, plausibly by 2x either way.

### SM-12 — cost/task

- unit: composite: {tokens_per_task: count, imputed_eur_per_task: EUR at meta.imputation_rate, metered_eur_per_task: EUR}
- source artifact: S5 cost accounting
- cadence: weekly
- evidence_source: real
- note: COMPOSITE BY DESIGN. Under flat-rate subscription execution the realised marginal cost is EUR 0 and a single-number metric is degenerate. Three components: tokens (always real), an imputed EUR figure at a declared rate (so the number means something), and the metered figure (real only when the fallback path runs). This stays ONE metric so len(scoreboard_metrics) == 22 holds rather than silently becoming 24.
